## Transform Data

Discrete Vs. Continuous

```{r}
# DISCRETE
dat_disc <- df[,4, drop = FALSE]
rownames(dat_disc) <- df$species
dat_disc <- as.matrix(dat_disc)

colnames(df)
head(df)

#CONTINUOUS
dat_cont <- df[, -(1:4), drop = FALSE]
rownames(dat_cont) <- df$species
dat_cont <- as.matrix(dat_cont)

```


## PHYLOGENY

```{r}
sum(df$species %in% tree$tip.label) # 121 species


tdat_cont <- treedata(tree,dat_cont)

```

## PLOT GENERA

```{r}
phy <- tdat_disc$phy

#pdf(
 #"C:/Users/maela/OneDrive/Documents/Files/3M Course/Assignment Stuff/GeneraPhylogeny.pdf",
 #width = 10,
  #height = 12
#)

#par(mar = c(6, 4, 4, 2) + 0.1)

# define genera (from each focal group)
focal_clades <- list(
  "Anomalopus" = c(
    "Anomalopus", "Calyptotis", "Coeranoscincus",
    "Coggeria", "Ophioscincus", "Concinnia",
    "Nangura", "Silvascincus"
  ),
  "Glaphyromorphus" = c("Glaphyromorphus", "Eulamprus"),
  "Hemiergis" = c("Hemiergis", "Eremiascincus"),
  "Lerista" = c("Lerista", "Ctenotus")
)

# extract genus (that is the name for each genus)
genus <- sub("_.*", "", phy$tip.label)

# getting the node for each focal group
nodes <- sapply(focal_clades, function(genera) {
  tips <- phy$tip.label[genus %in% genera]
  if (length(tips) > 1) getMRCA(phy, tips) else NA
})

box_cols <- c(
  "Anomalopus" = "violet",
  "Glaphyromorphus" = "blue",
  "Hemiergis" = "skyblue",
  "Lerista" = "maroon"
)

# plot tree
plot(
  phy, show.tip.label = TRUE,
  main = "121 species of Sphenomorphinae",
  cex = 0.5
)

par(xpd = NA)

legend(
  "bottom",
  inset = c(0, -0.15),
  legend = names(box_cols),
  pch = 21,
  pt.bg = box_cols,
  horiz = TRUE,
  bty = "n",
  cex = 0.9
)


# opaque outline
for (group in names(nodes)) {
  if (!is.na(nodes[group])) {
    box <- cladebox(
      node = nodes[group],
      col = adjustcolor(box_cols[group], alpha.f = 0.15)
    )
    
    polygon(
      box$x, box$y,
      col = NA,
      border = box_cols[group],
      lwd = 1.5
    )
  }
}

#dev.off()
```
## POLYMORPHOSPACE

```{r}
graphics.off()

#pdf(
 #"C:/Users/maela/OneDrive/Documents/Files/3M Course/Assignment Stuff/Polymorphospace.pdf",
 #width = 10,
  #height = 12
#)

tree <- tdat_disc$phy

focal_genera <- list(
  "Anomalopus" = c(
    "Anomalopus", "Calyptotis", "Coeranoscincus",
    "Coggeria", "Ophioscincus", "Concinnia",
    "Nangura", "Silvascincus"
  ),
  "Glaphyromorphus" = c("Glaphyromorphus", "Eulamprus"),
  "Hemiergis" = c("Hemiergis", "Eremiascincus"),
  "Lerista" = c("Lerista", "Ctenotus")
)

box_cols <- c(
  "Anomalopus" = "violet",
  "Glaphyromorphus" = "blue",
  "Hemiergis" = "skyblue",
  "Lerista" = "maroon"
)

# Assign focal groups
genus <- sub("_.*$", "", df$species)
df$focal_group <- NA_character_

for (grp in names(focal_genera)) {
  df$focal_group[genus %in% focal_genera[[grp]]] <- grp
}

limb_traits <- c("fll", "hll", "tll")

limb_labels <- c(
  fll = "Front limb length",
  hll = "Hind limb length",
  tll = "Total limb length"
)

# Reset plotting device and layout
layout(matrix(c(1, 2, 3,
                4, 4, 4),
              nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
       heights = c(4, 1))

par(mar = c(5, 4, 3, 1))


for (trait in limb_traits) {
  
  plot_df <- df[
    complete.cases(df[, c("species", "bd_wmean", trait)]) &
      df$species %in% tree$tip.label,
  ]
  
  X <- as.matrix(plot_df[, c("bd_wmean", trait)])
  rownames(X) <- plot_df$species
  colnames(X) <- c("Soil bulk density", limb_labels[trait])
  
  td <- geiger::treedata(
    phy = tree,
    data = X,
    sort = TRUE,
    warnings = TRUE
  )
  
  X_matched <- td$data[td$phy$tip.label, , drop = FALSE]
  
  # Match focal groups to the tree-tip order
  matched_rows <- match(td$phy$tip.label, plot_df$species)
  matched_groups <- plot_df$focal_group[matched_rows]
  point_cols <- unname(box_cols[matched_groups])
  
  # Draw branches and morphospace without visible tip symbols
  phytools::phylomorphospace(
    tree = td$phy,
    X = X_matched,
    label = "off",
    xlab = "Soil bulk density",
    ylab = limb_labels[trait],
    node.size = c(0, 0),
    pch = NA,
    col = "grey40",
    cex = 0
  )
  
  # Draw colored terminal nodes at the exact branch endpoints
  points(
    X_matched[, 1],
    X_matched[, 2],
    pch = 21,
    bg = point_cols,
    col = "black",
    cex = 1.1
  )
  
  title(main = paste("Soil density vs.", limb_labels[trait]))
}

#par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
par(mar = c(0,0,0,0))

plot.new()

legend(
  "center",
  legend = c("Focal Group", names(box_cols)),
  pch = c(NA, rep(21, length(box_cols))),
  pt.bg = c(NA, box_cols),
  col = c(NA, rep("black", length(box_cols))),
  horiz = TRUE,
  bty = "n",
  pt.cex = 2,
  x.intersp = 1.2,
  inset = c(-0.1, -0.15),
  cex = 1.4
)

#dev.off()
```

## REGRESSION PGLs (Maelan Code)

``` {r}

#pdf(
 #"C:/Users/maela/OneDrive/Documents/Files/3M Course/Assignment Stuff/RegressionPGL.pdf",
 #width = 10,
  #height = 12
#)

traits <- c("fll", "hll", "tll")

plots <- list()

for(i in seq_along(traits)) {

  trait <- traits[i]

  # Create dataset for this trait
  plot_dat <- df[, c("species","focal_group", "bd_wmean", trait)]
  plot_dat <- na.omit(plot_dat)

  # Comparative data object
  comp_dat <- comparative.data(
    phy = tdat_disc$phy,
    data = plot_dat,
    names.col = "species",
    vcv = TRUE
  )

  # PGLS model
  mod <- pgls(
    as.formula(paste(trait, "~ bd_wmean")),
    data = comp_dat,
    lambda = "ML"
  )

  print(summary(mod))

  # Create prediction values
  pred <- data.frame(
    bd_wmean = seq(
      min(plot_dat$bd_wmean),
      max(plot_dat$bd_wmean),
      length.out = 100
    )
  )

  pred$fit <- predict(mod, newdata = pred)

  # Plot
  plots[[i]] <- ggplot(plot_dat,
                       aes(x = bd_wmean,
                           y = .data[[trait]],
                           color = focal_group)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_line(
      data = pred,
      aes(x = bd_wmean, y = fit),
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
     scale_color_manual(
  values = c(
    "Anomalopus" = "violet",
    "Glaphyromorphus" = "blue",
    "Hemiergis" = "skyblue",
    "Lerista" = "maroon"
  ),
  name = "Focal Group"
)+
    theme_classic() +
    labs(
      x = "Soil bulk density",
  y = trait,
  title = c(
    "Front Limb Length",
    "Hind Limb Length",
    "Total Limb Length"
  )[i]
    )
  
}

# Display all three plots together
(plots[[1]] | plots[[2]] | plots[[3]]) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text (size = 14))

#dev.off()
```

## FIT MODELS (Maelan Code)

- the best fit for all traits is the pagel's lambda model

```{r}

traits <- c("fll", "hll", "tll")

model_results <- list()

for(trait in traits){

  trait_dat <- df[, c("species", trait)]
  trait_dat <- na.omit(trait_dat)

  trait_vec <- trait_dat[[trait]]
  names(trait_vec) <- trait_dat$species

  td <- treedata(tree, trait_vec)

  vec <- td$data[,1]
  names(vec) <- rownames(td$data)

  BM_fit <- fitContinuous(td$phy, vec, model = "BM")
  OU_fit <- fitContinuous(td$phy, vec, model = "OU")
  EB_fit <- fitContinuous(td$phy, vec, model = "EB")
  WN_fit <- fitContinuous(td$phy, vec, model = "white")
  Lambda_fit <- fitContinuous(td$phy, vec, model = "lambda")

  model_results[[trait]] <- data.frame(
    Trait = trait,
    Model = c("BM","OU","EB","White","Lambda"),
    logLik = c(
    BM_fit$opt$lnL,
    OU_fit$opt$lnL,
    EB_fit$opt$lnL,
    WN_fit$opt$lnL,
    Lambda_fit$opt$lnL
  ),
    AICc = c(
      BM_fit$opt$aicc,
      OU_fit$opt$aicc,
      EB_fit$opt$aicc,
      WN_fit$opt$aicc,
      Lambda_fit$opt$aicc
    )
  )
}

all_models <- do.call(rbind, model_results)

all_models <- all_models %>%
  group_by(Trait) %>%
  mutate(
    Delta_AICc = AICc - min(AICc),
    RelLik = exp(-0.5 * Delta_AICc),
    AkaikeWeight = RelLik / sum(RelLik)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Trait, Delta_AICc)

all_models
```
